purpose: Re-search H2 under the corrected Tetrp authority and 200k review regime. Treat the historical attack=1,cancel=0 result as a prior, not a carried-forward winner.

fixed_stack.authority: synchronous Tetrp TL with authority-validated reset-safe placement transport

grid_reason: The neutral (0,0) point is included as a deterministic A/A calibration against corrected_legacy_h12.
The historical winner (1,0) is included, but the search also covers weaker/stronger outgoing-attack reward and cancellation-only/joint variants.
The coarse range uses attack 0..1.5 and cancellation 0..1.0. If a promising point lands on an outer boundary, the next local study may extend that boundary rather than treating it as an optimum.

Negative H2 rewards are omitted because the feature semantics are explicitly to value useful outgoing attack and visible cancellation; negative coefficients reward the opposite behavior rather than representing a plausible alternative interpretation.

sampling.common_random_numbers: Every H2 coarse candidate uses the same 20 fresh asymmetric seed pairs.
sampling.pair_design: Game A candidate gets seed X in slot0 and incumbent seed Y in slot1; Game B swaps profile assignment so candidate gets seed Y in slot1.
sampling.independence: The 20 asymmetric pairs are the experimental units; 40 games are not 40 independent observations.

integrity_gates: Every candidate must have 20 complete asymmetric pairs / 40 scored games with no harness failures.
Each pair must contain the candidate once in slot0 and once in slot1.
The neutral tuner override (attack=0,cancel=0) must calibrate exactly: 20-20 KO, zero sweeps for either profile, and 20 split pairs.
The one-lock placement-transport guard must remain enabled.
Any correctness or calibration failure blocks interpretation; malformed games are never counted as losses.

analysis_plan.promising_signal: Positive net paired sweeps and >20/40 candidate KO wins are a coarse directional signal only.
analysis_plan.boundary_handling: A leading attack=1.5 or cancellation=1.0 point is a boundary signal, not an optimum.
analysis_plan.decision_after_run: Stop after producing the machine-readable summary. The next local-refinement grid is chosen by research judgment after inspecting the full pattern; do not auto-promote or auto-launch refinement.

no_promotion: This coarse sweep has no promotion authority. Only a later fixed finalist may receive large fresh confirmation.
